text:
anna: Quick ask from NorthStar 
b7 they want a compact perf/W + throughput run for marketplace SKU. Need kernel tuning notes and an embargoed figures page.

vish: How many racks and can we get PDU per-socket metering? Also driver stack?

northstar-ops: We have 3 racks (NS1-NS3). PDU per-socket at 1s. Can match driver stack on NS1/NS2; NS3 is older and kept for compatibility rows.

sam: Proposed matrix: model=crest-mini, seq=512/2048; modes=fp16,int8,q4_0; kernels=stock,fused-attn,cuBLAS-tuned. Powercaps: 280/230/180W. Include KV-cache thrash + steady-state windows.

tori: Telemetry minimum: run_id, ts, host_pdu_w, socket_w, gpu_power_w, latency_ms (p50/p95/p99), ipc, l2_miss. We'll share aggregated CSV + heatmaps. Raw traces require NDA addendum.

anna: Owners: Sam = bench ops; Vish = kernel tuning; Tori = telemetry & analysis; Anna = PM + announce. Agree?

vish: I'll test ATTEN_FUSE=1 and CUBLAS_TUNE=4 for tuned runs, plus jemalloc vs tcmalloc allocator variants.

bench-bot: Scheduled run created id=bench-1778889999 -> start=1778966400. Tests queued: fp16,int8,q4_0.

sam: Plan: dry-run Wed, tuning Thu, final sweep Fri if VPN & perfmon green. Need NorthStar to enable perfmon and kernel debug symbols on NS1/NS2.

northstar-ops: We'll enable perfmon Tue EOD on NS1/NS2; NS3 remains read-only for compatibility checks. Sending VPN creds via secure channel.

tori: Telemetry bucket: s3://redwood-northstar/bench-1778889999. Grant aggregated-read to northstar-marketing. Raw dumps pending NDA addendum.

anna: Legal check: partner requested raw kernel traces. Legal-bot?

legal-bot: Raw kernel traces are sensitive; NDA addendum recommended. Aggregated CSVs and plots may be shared without addendum. I'll start the addendum flow.

sam: Runner snippet for ops:
```bash
run-bench --model crest-mini --seq 2048 --modes fp16,int8,q4_0 \
  --dur 3600 --powercaps 280,230,180 \
  --telemetry s3://redwood-northstar/bench-1778889999 \
  --rigs NS1,NS2,NS3
```

vish: Add quality gate: compute token logprob delta vs baseline; flag any avg drop >0.5 for manual QA. Also attach 20 sample generations per run for spot-check.

anna: Timeline: Tue perfmon enable; Wed dry-run; Thu tune; Fri final sweep. NorthStar wants embargoed figures by next Mon for their comms. Feasible?

vish: Yes if tuning doesn't hit regressions. Recommend +1 day buffer.

sam: Action items: 1) NS ops to enable perfmon Tue. 2) Bench ops to prep harness + Console dashboard. 3) Kernel team to provide knobs + safe defaults. 4) Telemetry to create bucket and ACLs. 5) PM to open NDA addendum with Legal and draft embargo playbook.

anna: I'll send kickoff note to NorthStar and circulate the embargoed playbook draft. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
